messages.subject: rtimes and rsunlight pkgs
messages.body_plain:
Anyone want to take over the https://github.com/ropengov/rtimes and https://github.com/ropengov/rsunlight packages?  I'm spread too thin, and I don't ever use these pkgs myself. Ideally someone that uses this kind of data can maintain these. Any ideas?

Thanks, Scott

messages.subject: Re: rOpenGov: rtimes and rsunlight pkgs
messages.body_plain:
Hi Scott - great to hear from you and thanks for sending the note.  I am also not using these packages but there seems to be interest. They have quite some downloads per year. Not sure what's the best way to proceed. How much they seem to require maintenance in practice?

Leo

messages.subject: Re: rOpenGov: rtimes and rsunlight pkgs
messages.body_plain:
Well, for sunlight, their various APIs moved to Propublica b/c they droppped all their API services, so that's been a bit of work and not done yet I think.

For nytimes, their developers don't respond at all to inquiries, so that is a tough one whenever theirs problems on their end.
